description: ServiceNow inbound webhook handler for MCP request tickets. MUST: (1) Authenticate via SNOW OAuth token validation, not API key. (2) Validate request signature on every inbound POST. (3) Never accept unsigned webhooks - reject with 401. (4) Write incoming ticket data to mcp_submissions via write_service :8772. (5) Extract mcp_name, requested_by, request_timestamp. (6) Include audit_log entry for every inbound. Priority 0.92 per Phase 9 spec. Do NOT implement outbound ServiceNow calls - only inbound receives.
